name: The Sandy and John Black Pavilion at Ole Miss

bagPolicy.summary: The official Pavilion event announcement for a January 2026 watch party says its clear-bag policy was in effect, but does not give concert bag dimensions. Consult the individual concert announcement for bag limits.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
